description: Contributor RBAC role on a subscription/resource group - deploy resources, run commands, and read managed-identity tokens across the scope.
prerequisite_privilege: Contributor (or Owner) on the target scope
abuse_primitive: Deploy a resource / run-command / read a managed identity token to pivot; e.g. az vm run-command, ARM template deployment.

telemetry.detail: Azure Activity log records the ARM write/action (resource create, run-command, deployment). Default-on, but Contributor writes blend with legitimate admin activity.
Defender for Cloud (Resource Manager plan) can alert on anomalous/suspicious ARM operations; requires the paid plan.
If the deployed payload or run-command runs on an EDR-onboarded host, it is caught on-host.

notes: Broad and common role, so the control-plane write is logged but rarely alert-worthy on its own; the follow-on compute/identity abuse is the louder signal.
